name: test-results-canvas
description: GitHub Copilot canvas extension that renders .NET TRX and JUnit XML test runs as a live UI panel.

scripts.test:ci: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('test-results',{recursive:true})" && node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/unit-junit.xml test/labels.test.ts test/trx.test.ts test/junit.test.ts
